result:
What a refreshing question!

If I could change the world in one way, I would make it so that every person on this planet has access to clean, safe, and affordable drinking water. Water is a fundamental human right, and yet, millions of people around the world struggle to get enough of it every day.

I would make sure that every community, no matter how remote or disadvantaged, has a reliable source of clean drinking water. This would involve investing in infrastructure, implementing sustainable water management practices, and protecting natural water sources from pollution.

Having access to clean drinking water would have a ripple effect on so many aspects of life, from improving public health and sanitation to supporting economic development and education. It's a change that would have a profound impact on the well-being and dignity of people everywhere.
